Under the direction of Marcus Marienfeld, the team creates small works of art - individually adapted to the respective anatomy on request. After all, the wearer should be as comfortable as possible. The laser beam can be adjusted so finely that it can even be used to polish weld seam. However this requires a great deal of experience and skilled hands. And of course a good eye. Marienfeld knows from experience working independently is his trademark.

INTRO_KR: PT. Atalla Indonesia which was established in 2000 with a total of 20 employees is a company which is engaged in the industry of eyeglass frames and other optical needs. When PT. Atalla Indonesia was established in 2000, many are pessimistic about the continuity of our company. This is due in the year 2000 is the beginning of the decline of the Indonesian economy, especially in the field of industry. This is due to the following: 1. Conflicting political and economic and security situations; 2. Unstable rupiah exchange rate 3. Labor demos accompanied by violence and coercion; 4. Illegal imported products, especially from the People's Republic of China (PRC) that inundated the Indonesian market; 5. Loan interest rates are quite high; 6. A lot of unemployment, so people's purchasing power is weak. At this time PT. Atalla Indonesia has more than 400 employees and produces 2,500 dozen or 30,000 glasses per day. PT.
